evidence.title: tinyworld.marutto.art | Make and share a tiny world

name: tinyworld.marutto.art
summary: Web app for building diorama-style tiny worlds from item materials, then sharing, favouriting and remixing them.
description: A browser app where you drop items into a small diorama world and post it. The site has a community gallery of top-loved and recently updated worlds, photo spots, a growing material catalog, creator profiles and a reMix action that copies any world into your own editor; no login is needed to start creating.
contains: diorama world builder in the browser
gallery: top-loved worlds, recently updated, recent spots, creators
catalog of item materials to place
reMix action to fork another world
